notes.title: There is a Thief in my House 1 year anniversary!
notes.notes:
I spent the last months refurbishing the game - graphics, maps, performance, sound, gameplay, UI, a new voice actor. I also rearranged the order of levels (going from easy to hard). New or different looking maps/environments and a whole new main menu. 
I made a little video showing all the improvements and updates that have been made throughout the year (most of them came with the new update): 
[previewyoutube=YoRax8F8CCk;full][/previewyoutube]
